intent: Individually authored tasks preserve preference roles, refusal choice, offers, restriction scope and unanswered questions.
picturePurpose: Original paired bags support a separate exact coded-weight comparison; weight is never inferred from generated appearance.

workshop.instruction: 先摆正更喜欢的活动，再按练习重量选包、关掉示意闪光灯。

transfer.stem: Which notes correctly preserve the preference, the museum restriction and the shop question?
transfer.passage:
Choices on a school visit
I prefer walking to waiting for a crowded bus. Walking is the preferred activity in this comparison, but it does not mean I will never take a bus again. We agree that a handle needs to be stronger; we have not said that it has been repaired. You can refuse a request that makes you uncomfortable. This gives you a choice, rather than requiring you to accept or refuse every request.
At the shop, we ask, "Will the shop accept a return without a receipt?" The question does not tell us the shop’s answer or policy. I can offer to carry the lighter bag. Offering is not the same as already carrying it. In a separate comparison exercise, the left bag is labelled 3 kg and the right 5 kg. Those practice labels, not the bags’ colours or visible sizes, identify the lighter bag. They are not weights supplied by the original sentence.
The museum does not allow flash photography. We switch the schematic flash setting off; the activity never uses a real camera. The sentence does not give every other photography rule, so we must check those separately. On our outdoor walk, we avoid walking near the cliff edge. No exact distance is stated or guaranteed safe.

options.text: Waiting is preferred; all photography is banned; the shop certainly accepts the return.
Walking is preferred; flash photography is banned; acceptance is still a question.
Walking is preferred; every non-flash photo is certainly allowed; acceptance is still a question.
Waiting is preferred; flash photography is banned; acceptance is still a question.

answer.display: Walking is preferred; flash photography is banned; acceptance is still a question.
